objects.text: The Alana Hotel & Conference Center merupakan hotel bintang 4 berkonsep modern-ethnic di bawah naungan Archipelago International, yang menawarkan perpaduan desain tradisional, kenyamanan modern, serta fasilitas pusat konvensi untuk bisnis maupun keluarga.

objects.text:
Warmest greetings from The Alana. It is a true honor to welcome you to the heart of Yogyakarta. Your presence with us is not only a privilege, but also a moment of pride for our entire team.

Thank you for choosing The Alana. We sincerely hope your experience here will be memorable and filled with the warmth of our genuine hospitality.

With highest regards,
Nanang Sumardjono
General Manager
